units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 40b:14">Bekh. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>והרי ת׳ בעלמא הוא</he> but (if there is no bone in it,) then it is a mere wart.—Pl. <he>תִּלְתּוּלִין</he>, <cite ref="V00627"><he>תִּילְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 40b:14">Ib.</cite> <he>בעלי הת׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>התִּילּוּלִין</he>) those with warts, if human beings, are unfit (for priesthood), if beasts, are fit (for the altar); <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">ib. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b">45ᵇ</cite>) Rashi (ed. <he>דלדולין</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:12">Tosef. Neg. II, 12</cite> <cite ref="V00639"><he>תַּלְתַּלִּין</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 2:5:2">Y. Erub. II, 20ᵇ</cite> <he>תשעה עשר תלתולין</he>, read: <he>תלתותין</he>, v. <cite ref="V00632"><he>תַּלְתּוּתָא</he></cite>.]
